title: 第419章 邪魔大世界第418章 扯虎皮做旗
slug: 凡人修仙我百世轮回成道祖
content_zh:
第419章：邪魔大世界
耀穹星。
作为玄黄大世界最边缘的资源副星，
它的另一面，
正对着茫茫黑暗的无人星域。
穿越这片荒芜星域，亿万光年距离，便是邪魔大世界。
……
这日清晨，
星港之上罡风凛冽。
韩益善收起名册，
看向身旁的陈默，沉声问道：
“王道友，你当真想好了？邪魔大世界凶险莫测，仇劫与姬豪杰都在那里……一旦暴露身份，便是万劫不复。”
“想好了。”
陈默点头，
语气平静却坚定，
“躲在玄黄等对方打过来，永远是被动挨打……所以最好的防御，是主动出击。”
“既如此，
我等便助道友一臂之力！”
韩益善不再多劝，
转身示意众人动身，“出发！”

一行人身形腾空，
径直冲入无人星域。
……
肉身横渡星空，
道器破开空间，
瞬间腾挪。
起初尚且平稳，
众人皆是羽化境万古巨头，
天龙之力护体，
即便不借道器，也能肉身横渡虚空，罡风与陨石雨根本近不了身。
可越是接近邪魔大世界，
周遭环境便越是恶劣。
荒芜的星空中，
有时，
毫无征兆便会刮起一道虚空风暴，
乱流撕扯之下，
连空间都被拧成麻花，
随处可见漆黑的空间裂缝，
内里混沌翻涌，
content_en:
Chapter 419: The Great World of Demons
Shining star.
As the most peripheral resource star of the Xuanhuang world,
its other side,
Facing the vast and dark uninhabited star field.
Traveling through this desolate star field, a distance of hundreds of millions of light years, is the world of evil spirits.
…
This morning,
The wind was fierce above the star port.
Han Yishan put away the roster,
Looking at Chen Mo beside him, he asked in a deep voice:
"Fellow Daoist Wang, have you seriously thought about it? The evil world is dangerous and unpredictable. Qiu Jie and Ji Haojie are both there... Once their identities are exposed, they will be doomed."
"Think about it."
Chen Mo nodded,
His tone was calm but firm,
"Hide in Xuanhuang and wait for the opponent to attack. You will always be passively beaten... so the best defense is to take the initiative."
"That being the case,
I'll be there to help fellow Taoists! "
Han Yishan stopped trying to persuade him.
He turned around and motioned for everyone to start, "Let's go!"
A group of people soared into the air,
Rush straight into the uninhabited star field.
…
The body crosses the starry sky,
The Taoist weapon breaks open the space,
Move instantly.
It was calm at first,
Everyone is an eternal giant in the Ascension Realm,
The power of heavenly dragon protects the body,
Even without borrowing a Taoist weapon, he can physically cross the void, and the Gangfeng and Meteor Rain cannot get close to him.
But the closer we get to the evil world,
The surrounding environment becomes worse.
In the barren starry sky,
sometimes,
A void storm will blow up without warning,
Torn apart by turbulent currents,
Even the space has been twisted into twists,
Dark space cracks can be seen everywhere,
Chaos surges inside,
